## The same evidence, four kinds of decisions

[Every project starts from one question you need answered. We bring the data, the method and the reading of a scientist.]{.lead}
:::

::: {.grid .grid-2}
::: {.card-cx .reveal}
[01]{.card-num}

### Funders and institutions

Understand a research field before you fund it, and see who is left out.

- Research evaluation
- Equity and leadership analysis
- Evidence for priority setting

[Research evaluation](services.qmd#evaluation){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card-cx .reveal}
[02]{.card-num}

### Biotech and investors

See who is inventing what, where the space is crowded, and where it is open.

- Patent landscapes
- Research and competitor mapping
- Partner and talent scouting

[Landscape reports](services.qmd#landscapes){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card-cx .reveal}
[03]{.card-num}

### Researchers and students

Find and screen the literature faster, with methods you can trust and repeat.

- Evidence synthesis support
- AI-assisted screening, validated
- Hands-on workshops

[Evidence and training](services.qmd#evidence){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card-cx .reveal}
[04]{.card-num}

### African research partners

Lead studies on the health problems that matter where you work, with data and methods you keep.

- Research mapping for grant applications
- Co-led studies and shared authorship
- Training in English and French

[Research in Africa](projects/research-in-africa.qmd){.card-link}
:::
:::
:::
:::

[How we work]{.eyebrow}

## From a question to an answer you can use
:::

::: {.grid .grid-4 .steps}
::: {.step .reveal}
[Step 1]{.card-num}

### Define the question

We agree on what you need to decide, and what a good answer looks like.
:::

::: {.step .reveal}
[Step 2]{.card-num}

### Gather the data

Publications, patents, grants and trials, from open and trusted sources.
:::

::: {.step .reveal}
[Step 3]{.card-num}

### Screen and check

AI helps sort the records; people check the results against a hand-labelled sample.
:::

::: {.step .reveal}
[Step 4]{.card-num}

### Deliver clear answers

A short report, charts and, when useful, an interactive dashboard.
:::
:::
:::
:::

## {{< var workshop_title >}}

Five live online workshops, one Saturday a month, for researchers in French-speaking Africa, Europe and Canada. From 10,000 FCFA (about €15) in Africa; €60 elsewhere.

[Reserve a seat]({{< var workshop_waitlist_url >}}){.btn-cx}
[See all workshops](workshops.qmd){.btn-cx-ghost}
:::

::: {.reveal}
::: {.card-cx}
[Saturdays, 15:00–18:00 UTC · taught in French]{.card-num}

- 30 Jan: Map a research field in 3 hours
- 27 Feb: Screen the literature with AI, and check it
- 27 Mar: Read a patent landscape
- 24 Apr: Evaluate research responsibly
- 29 May: From data to paper
